name: EnumItem
simple: An EnumItem is one option from an Enum list, like Enum.Material.Wood or Enum.KeyCode.E. You use them to set properties and to check what something is. Each one has a Name, a number Value, and knows which Enum it belongs to.
analogy: If an Enum is a restaurant menu, an EnumItem is one dish on it. The dish has a name ("Pizza"), a menu number (#12), and you know which menu it came from.
whenToUse: Checking which key was pressed, like input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E
Saving an option as text (Name) or a number (Value)
where: Available everywhere. Get one with Enum.<EnumName>.<ItemName>, like Enum.Material.Wood.

terms.enum: A fixed list of named options, like Enum.Material.
terms.integer: A whole number with no decimal part.

examples.title: Do something when the E key is pressed
examples.code:
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then
		return -- the player was typing in chat, ignore
	end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
		print("You pressed E!")
		print(input.KeyCode.Name, input.KeyCode.Value) --> E 101
	end
end)
explain: InputBegan fires whenever the player presses a key or button.
gameProcessed is true when Roblox already used the key, like typing in chat.
input.KeyCode is an EnumItem. We compare it with Enum.KeyCode.E.
The EnumItem's Name is "E" and its Value is 101.

gotchas: Compare EnumItems directly (input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E), not their names as strings.
EnumItems from different enums are never equal, even if they share a name.

EnumItem.Name.simple: The name of this option as text, like "Wood". Handy for printing or saving.

EnumItem.Value.simple: The whole number that belongs to this option. Handy for saving, and Enum:FromValue can turn it back into the EnumItem.

EnumItem.EnumType.simple: The Enum list this option belongs to. Enum.Material.Wood.EnumType is Enum.Material.
EnumItem.EnumType.example:
local item = Enum.Material.Wood
print(item.EnumType == Enum.Material) --> true
